name: Darjeeling Hill Station Tour
description: A private cab journey from Kolkata into the Himalayan foothills, where the 'Queen of Hills' welcomes travellers with crisp mountain air and sweeping views of Kanchenjunga. The itinerary pairs the charm of a heritage toy-train ride and manicured tea estates with a predawn visit to Tiger Hill for that famous golden sunrise.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Darjeeling
itinerary.details: Departure from your Kolkata doorstep happens early so you can cover the long stretch on NH12 and pass through the plains of Siliguri before the road starts climbing. You should reach Darjeeling by early evening and check into your hotel. The rest of the night is yours to wander Mall Road and Chowrasta, soak in the bazaar buzz, and try some local momos.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.details: The day begins before dawn with a drive to Tiger Hill for the sunrise over Kanchenjunga, followed by stops at Batasia Loop and its War Memorial, Ghoom Monastery, and the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway museum. The afternoon rounds off the town circuit with the Peace Pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Zoo, and a stroll through a working tea estate. The evening is set aside for souvenir shopping in the local markets.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Kolkata
itinerary.details: After breakfast the drive takes you to the Rock Garden and Ganga Maya Park for a final taste of the hills. From there the return journey retraces the route down through Siliguri and along NH12, with your cab dropping you back at your Kolkata address by evening.

name: Puri & Konark Temple Tour
description: A road trip from Kolkata that pairs the sacred with the coastal, taking you to the spires of the Jagannath Temple at Puri and the colossal stone chariot of the UNESCO-listed Konark Sun Temple. Golden sands, a village of living Pattachitra art, and the wide waters of Chilika Lake round out the experience on this compact two-day package.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Puri
itinerary.details: The cab picks you up at first light and heads south on NH16 along the coast, with lunch time arrival planned in Puri. The afternoon is devoted to the Jagannath Temple and a stretch of Puri Beach, before the evening brings you to Swargadwar Beach and the lively sea-facing market for local sweets and crafts.

itinerary.title: Konark & Return
itinerary.details: Morning starts at the Konark Sun Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage marvel built to resemble the Sun God's chariot, followed by Chandrabhaga Beach and the artisan village of Raghurajpur. The return leg heads back up NH16 to Kolkata, with the cab dropping you home late in the evening.

name: Sundarbans Mangrove Safari Tour
description: Glide into the largest mangrove forest on the planet, a tangle of tidal creeks and islands that shelters the Royal Bengal Tiger, on a two-day escape from Kolkata. The itinerary hinges on guided boat safaris past watchtowers and mudbank clearings where crocodiles, spotted deer, and rarer birds are often seen.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Sundarbans
itinerary.details: Your cab heads south in the morning to Godkhali jetty, a drive of roughly three hours, where the road trip gives way to a motorised boat ride into the mangroves. The day includes a stop at Sajnekhali Watch Tower, a short forest walk, and an afternoon spent threading through the maze of narrow creeks before settling into an eco resort for the night.

itinerary.title: Safari & Return
itinerary.details: An early cruise along the quieter channels is the best bet for spotting tigers, saltwater crocodiles, and kingfishers; a climb up the Sudhanyakhali Watch Tower widens the view over the waterways. After a late lunch the boat ferries you back to Godkhali, from where the cab retraces the road to Kolkata and drops you home by evening.

included: Private AC cab for the Kolkata–Godkhali–Kolkata leg
Fuel for the full road segment

name: Varanasi & Ayodhya Spiritual Tour
description: Three days spent moving between the ghats of Varanasi and the temple town of Ayodhya, touching two of north India's holiest sites on one road trip from Kolkata. Expect the evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, a dawn boat ride on the Ganges, and darshan at Kashi Vishwanath before the journey continues to the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Varanasi
itinerary.details: The cab leaves Kolkata in the early hours and tracks NH19 across the plains of Bihar, pulling into Varanasi by evening. As dusk settles you head to Dashashwamedh Ghat for the Ganga Aarti, then wander the dense, old lanes of the city where shrines and sweet shops crowd shoulder to shoulder.

itinerary.title: Varanasi Sightseeing & Ayodhya
itinerary.details: A sunrise boat ride along the Ganges sets the tone before visits to Kashi Vishwanath and Annapurna temples and the Buddhist site of Sarnath. Lunch is followed by a four-to-five-hour drive to Ayodhya, where the evening ends with the Saryu River Aarti on the ghats.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya & Return
itinerary.details: The morning opens with darshan at Ram Mandir, then Hanuman Garhi and Ram Ki Paidi before the long haul home. The cab retraces the route back to Kolkata, arriving late in the evening at your doorstep.

included: All fuel for the round trip

name: Bodh Gaya & Rajgir Buddhist Circuit Tour
description: A short pilgrimage loop from Patna through the heart of the Buddhist circuit, centred on the Mahabodhi Temple where the Buddha is said to have attained enlightenment beneath the Bodhi Tree. The route also takes in the ruined campus of Nalanda University and the hillside sanctuaries of Rajgir with their hot springs and ropeway climbs.

itinerary.title: Patna to Bodh Gaya
itinerary.details: Pickup from Patna in the morning and a comfortable two-to-three-hour drive brings you to Bodh Gaya. The afternoon is spent at the Mahabodhi Temple complex, the Bodhi Tree, the Great Buddha Statue, and the international prayer halls built by the Thai, Japanese, and Tibetan communities, with time left for an evening of quiet meditation around the temple grounds.

itinerary.title: Rajgir, Nalanda & Return
itinerary.details: A morning drive delivers you to Rajgir for the hot springs, a ropeway ride up to Griddhakuta Peak, the Japanese Peace Pagoda, and the deer park of Venuvan. Heading back, the tour pauses at the extensive ruins and museum of ancient Nalanda before the cab completes the run to Patna by evening.

name: Deoghar Baidyanath Dham Pilgrimage Tour
description: A pilgrimage drive from Ranchi to one of the twelve Jyotirlingas at Baidyanath Dham in Deoghar, wrapped into a tidy two-day package. Beyond the main shrine, the trip folds in the Basukinath temple and a string of local landmarks around town for a devotional trip that doesn't feel rushed.

itinerary.title: Ranchi to Deoghar
itinerary.details: The cab leaves Ranchi in the morning and makes the five-to-six-hour run to Deoghar on the Dumka road. Afternoon darshan at the Baidyanath Dham Jyotirlinga is followed by the Naulakha Mandir and a ride up Nandan Pahar, and the night is spent at a hotel in Deoghar.

itinerary.title: Basukinath & Return
itinerary.details: An early start takes you the 30 kilometres to Basukinath Temple for morning prayers before heading back into Deoghar for Tapovan Hills and a browse through the local bazaar. After lunch the cab makes the return run to Ranchi, dropping you off by evening.

included: Air-conditioned cab for the entire trip

name: Kolkata Heritage City Tour
description: One full day in the City of Joy, covering the grand Victorian landmarks, riverfront icons, and the most revered temples in a private cab from your own doorstep. From the marble domes of Victoria Memorial to the bustle of Howrah Bridge and the sanctity of Dakshineswar and Kalighat, the route squeezes in Kolkata's essential sights in eight to ten hours.

itinerary.title: Full Day Kolkata Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Pickup happens at your location in the morning, with the first stops at Dakshineswar Kali Temple and Belur Math across the river. The tour then rolls over Howrah Bridge to Marble Palace and the Indian Museum, breaks for lunch around Park Street, and finishes the afternoon at Victoria Memorial, St. Paul's Cathedral, and Kalighat Temple. Weather permitting, the evening closes with Science City or a sunset stop at Prinsep Ghat before the drop-off.

included: Private AC cab for 8 hours / 80 km

name: North Bengal Complete Tour
description: A five-day sweep across the roof of the eastern Himalayas, stringing together Darjeeling's tea-scented ridges, the monastery-lined streets of Gangtok, and the elephant-grass country of the Dooars. Families and nature lovers get the full menu — a sunrise at Tiger Hill, a heritage toy-train ride, a high-altitude lake, and jungle safaris in Jaldapara and Gorumara.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Siliguri/Darjeeling
itinerary.details: An early departure from Kolkata runs up NH12 to Siliguri and then climbs the foothills to Darjeeling, a total of ten to twelve hours on the road. Once checked in, the evening is left free for a slow stroll along Mall Road before dinner.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.details: Before sunrise you're at Tiger Hill watching the Kanchenjunga massif light up, followed by Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery, a toy-train ride, the Peace Pagoda, and a tea estate. The afternoon brings the Padmaja Naidu Zoo and the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, and the night is again in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Gangtok
itinerary.details: The drive east along the Teesta river valley takes four to five hours to reach Gangtok. The afternoon is spent on MG Marg, at Enchey Monastery, and on the Gangtok Ropeway, with the evening given over to the market lanes around town.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Sightseeing & to Dooars
itinerary.details: Subject to permit availability, the morning runs up to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir before heading back into Gangtok. After lunch the drive swings south to the Dooars region near Lataguri, a five-to-six-hour stretch, for the night at a forest-side property.

itinerary.title: Dooars Safari & Return
itinerary.details: An early jeep safari through Jaldapara or Gorumara National Park looks for rhino, elephants, and bison, with a spin through the Chapramari Wildlife area to follow. After lunch the cab returns via Siliguri all the way to Kolkata, arriving late in the evening.

included: AC vehicle for the whole circuit
Overnight halt charges for the driver

name: Dehradun Mussoorie Weekend Tour
description: A compact weekend retreat from Delhi to the ridge town of Mussoorie, with a detour through Dehradun for the sulphur springs at Sahastradhara. Waterfalls, a cable-car viewpoint, and the ever-busy Mall Road make this an easy, scenic breather from city life.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Mussoorie
itinerary.details: Morning pickup in Delhi, then a drive up to Mussoorie via Dehradun with a break at the sulphur springs of Sahastradhara. The evening belongs to Mall Road, where the cool weather and shopfronts keep things lively well into the night.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Sightseeing & Return
itinerary.details: The day tours Kempty Falls, the Gun Hill ropeway viewpoint, and the flower-filled Company Garden before lunch. From there the cab cruises back down to Delhi, arriving in the late evening.

name: Nainital Lake Tour
description: Three easy days in Nainital, the crescent-shaped lake town of the Kumaon hills, on a relaxed cab tour from Delhi. Rowing on the lake, ridge-top viewpoints, the Naina Devi Temple, and unhurried Mall Road evenings fill out an itinerary built for unwinding.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Nainital
itinerary.details: Departure from Delhi in the morning puts you in Nainital by evening, with time to settle into your hotel. Once checked in, a short boat ride on Naini Lake gives a first taste of the town's quiet charm.

itinerary.title: Nainital Sightseeing
itinerary.details: A full day of sightseeing takes in Snow View Point, the picnic lawns of Tiffin Top, the Naina Devi Temple, and plenty of shopping along Mall Road. The lake-front lights up again after dark for a stroll and dinner.

itinerary.title: Return to Delhi
itinerary.details: After breakfast the road home makes a stop at Bhimtal or Sattal for a quick lakeside look before the cab winds back to Delhi, arriving late in the evening.

name: Jim Corbett Safari Tour
description: A quick dash from Delhi to India's oldest tiger reserve for a weekend of jeep safaris in Jim Corbett National Park. With its forested Kumaon foothills, the Corbett Museum, and the Garjia temple above the Kosi, the trip packs wildlife and local history into two days.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Jim Corbett
itinerary.details: An early start from Delhi brings you to the park's edge in time for a safari in the Bijrani or Jhirna zone, scanning for tigers, elephants, and sambar as the forest cools in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Safari & Return
itinerary.details: A morning safari, the best slot for tiger sightings, is followed by a visit to the Corbett Museum and the riverside Garjia Temple. After lunch the cab makes the return drive to Delhi, arriving in the evening.

name: Agra Taj Mahal Day Tour
description: A same-day round trip from Delhi to the marbled monuments of Agra, led by the Taj Mahal at sunrise pace and rounded out with Agra Fort and the ghost city of Fatehpur Sikri. The Yamuna Expressway keeps the journey short enough to fit the Mughal icons into a single, relaxed day.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Agra & Return
itinerary.details: Departing Delhi at first light, the cab takes the Yamuna Expressway straight to Agra for a morning at the Taj Mahal, then Agra Fort and the Itimad-ud-Daulah mausoleum. An afternoon stop at Fatehpur Sikri on the way back completes the day before the return run to Delhi by evening.

included: AC cab for the round trip

name: Varanasi Ayodhya Pilgrimage Tour
description: A longer, more measured pilgrimage route from Kolkata that gives Varanasi a full two days before moving on to Ayodhya. Ghat-side ceremonies, the Kashi Vishwanath shrine, the Buddhist ruins at Sarnath, and the grand Ram Mandir all feature in the four-day stretch.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Varanasi
itinerary.details: The cab drives from Kolkata to Varanasi through the day, arriving in the holy city by evening. After settling in, the first Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat waits with its fire-lit boats and chanting.

itinerary.title: Varanasi Sightseeing
itinerary.details: A full Varanasi day unfolds with darshan at Kashi Vishwanath, a visit to the Buddhist site of Sarnath, the riverside fort at Ramnagar, and a boat ride on the Ganga. The unhurried pace leaves room to watch the ghats come alive at sundown.

itinerary.title: Varanasi to Ayodhya
itinerary.details: After breakfast the drive heads to Ayodhya for a tour of Ram Mandir, Hanuman Garhi, and the richly decorated Kanak Bhawan. The rest of the day is free for a quieter walk along the Saryu ghats.

itinerary.title: Return to Kolkata
itinerary.details: A final round of darshan and prayers in the morning, then the long road journey back to Kolkata begins, with the cab pulling up at your address late in the evening.

included: AC cab for the whole tour

name: Khajuraho Temple Tour
description: A long-haul heritage drive from Kolkata to the sandstone temples of Khajuraho, whose carvings earned the site a UNESCO listing. The tour pairs the famous Western Group — headlined by Kandariya Mahadeva — with the plunge pools of Raneh Falls and a possible swing through Panna National Park.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Khajuraho
itinerary.details: The longest leg of the tour begins early from Kolkata and tracks west via the Varanasi route, putting you in Khajuraho by late evening. The night is spent at a hotel in the temple town.

itinerary.title: Khajuraho Sightseeing
itinerary.details: A full day is given to the temple groups — Western, Eastern, and Southern — with Kandariya Mahadeva and its dense lattice of sculpture the clear highlight. Time permitting, an afternoon excursion reaches Raneh Falls on the Ken river.

itinerary.title: Return to Kolkata
itinerary.details: If the schedule allows, a morning drive takes you through Panna National Park before the return leg sets out. The cab then heads back to Kolkata on the long road home.

name: Golden Triangle Tour (Delhi-Agra-Jaipur)
description: The classic north India circuit — Delhi's monuments, Agra's Taj Mahal, and Jaipur's rose-pink fortresses — compressed into four road-borne days. Forts, palaces, and the country's most photographed tomb make this the essential first taste of India's Mughal and Rajput past.

itinerary.title: Delhi Sightseeing
itinerary.details: The tour opens in the capital with Red Fort, India Gate, Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb, and the lotus-shaped Bahai temple, a full loop through seven centuries of Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Agra
itinerary.details: A morning run down the Yamuna Expressway lands you in Agra in time for the Taj Mahal at its most photogenic. Agra Fort, the riverside red sandstone stronghold of the Mughals, closes out the day's sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Agra to Jaipur
itinerary.details: En route to Rajasthan the tour pauses at the abandoned Mughal capital of Fatehpur Sikri before continuing to Jaipur. The afternoon introduces the pink city with Hawa Mahal and the City Palace.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Delhi
itinerary.details: A morning excursion scales the hilltop Amber Fort and the old observatory of Nahargarh before the drive back to Delhi, where the golden triangle closes by evening.

name: Bhopal Sanchi Pachmarhi Tour
description: A three-day drive into the heart of India, threading together the lakeside city of Bhopal, the ancient Buddhist stupas of Sanchi, and the forests and waterfalls of Pachmarhi. It's a varied loop — urban ghats, 2,300-year-old relics, and Madhya Pradesh's one true hill station.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Bhopal
itinerary.details: The cab covers the long miles to Bhopal through the day, arriving in time for a lakeside look at Upper Lake. A late-afternoon visit to the massive Taj-ul-Masajid mosque completes the day in the city.

itinerary.title: Sanchi & Pachmarhi
itinerary.details: A morning excursion visits the Great Stupa at Sanchi, a UNESCO site ringed with carved gateways, before the drive continues to Pachmarhi. The afternoon winds down at Bee Falls, one of the region's best-known cascades.

itinerary.title: Return to Delhi
itinerary.details: A last look around Pachmarhi's viewpoints and jungle trails in the morning, then the cab strikes back north toward Delhi, arriving in the late evening.

name: Haridwar Rishikesh Spiritual Tour
description: A weekend spent on the banks of the Ganga between Haridwar's temple ghats and Rishikesh's yoga studios and suspension bridges. Between the evening aarti at Har Ki Pauri and the two river jhulas, it's a compact immersion in the spirituality the region is known for.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Haridwar
itinerary.details: A morning drive from Delhi reaches Haridwar by afternoon, with time for Har Ki Pauri and a cable-car ride up to Mansa Devi. As dusk falls, the famous Ganga Aarti at the ghat takes centre stage.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh & Return
itinerary.details: After a short drive to Rishikesh, the tour crosses both Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula, and visits the Beatles Ashram before any optional rafting or riverside lunch. The cab then heads back to Delhi, dropping you off in the evening.

name: Kolkata Beach Tour (Digha-Mandarmani)
description: A two-day seaside break from Kolkata that splits its time between the busy sands of Digha and the quieter, crab-strewn shoreline of Mandarmani. Between beach strolls there's room for the Chandaneswar temple and a stop at the fishing village of Shankarpur.

itinerary.title: Kolkata to Digha & Mandarmani
itinerary.details: A morning drive out of Kolkata reaches Digha by midday, with the afternoon free for Old and New Digha beaches and a short visit to the Chandaneswar Temple. As evening approaches the cab continues down the coast to Mandarmani for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mandarmani & Return
itinerary.details: A barefoot morning walk along Mandarmani's wide beach — famous for its red crabs — is the highlight before a stop at the fishing harbour of Shankarpur. After lunch the drive returns to Kolkata, arriving by evening.

included: AC cab for the round trip

name: Patna Rajgir Nalanda Heritage Tour
description: A heritage loop through Bihar's ancient heartland, taking in the excavated university at Nalanda and the temple-dotted hills of Rajgir in two easy days from Patna. Buddhist ruins, therapeutic hot springs, and the marble Jal Mandir at Pawapuri form the core of the route.

itinerary.title: Patna to Rajgir via Nalanda
itinerary.details: After a morning visit to the Bihar Museum, the drive heads south to the sprawling ruins and museum of Nalanda University. The tour then continues to Rajgir for its hot springs and a climb or ropeway to Vulture Peak, with the night spent in the area.

itinerary.title: Pawapuri & Return
itinerary.details: The morning takes you to Pawapuri's Jal Mandir, its white marble temple rising from the middle of a lotus-filled lake, plus the Son Bhandar caves near Rajgir. The afternoon brings the short drive back to Patna.

name: Ranchi Netarhat Hill Station Tour
description: Two days up in the sal and magnolia forests of Netarhat, the highest hill station of the Chhotanagpur plateau and a short, scenic drive from Ranchi. Sunrises over the forested plateau, waterfall plunges, and an en-route stop at Betla National Park make this a restorative weekend escape.

itinerary.title: Ranchi to Netarhat
itinerary.details: The drive from Ranchi climbs steadily through forested hills to Netarhat, arriving by early afternoon. Magnolia Point and the upper falls at Ghagri are the day's sights, and the viewpoint above the plateau is a fine place to watch the sunset.

itinerary.title: Sunrise & Return
itinerary.details: An early morning at the Netarhat sunrise point is the trip's centrepiece, with the sun rising over an unbroken sea of forest. On the way back to Ranchi the cab pauses at Betla National Park, allowing a quick wildlife area look before the return drive.
